english.title: Criminal damage to property valued under £5000 - offender under 16 - PILOT FORCES ONLY
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful excuse,

(A)_[destroyed **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..)]_
(B)_[damaged **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..)]_

to the value of **(..SPECIFY VALUE UNDER FIVE THOUSAND POUNDS..) belonging to **(..SPECIFY NAME..) intending to destroy or damage such property or being reckless as to whether such property would be destroyed or damaged
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1(1) and 4 of the Criminal Damage Act 1971
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful excuse destroyed/damaged property valued under £5000
intending to destroy/damage such property OR
being reckless whether it was destroyed/damaged

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - PND Code DX11 . FOR USE BY PILOT FORCES ONLY.

other.penalty:
Penalty Notice for Disorder by offender aged under 16 - Forty pounds - where the value is under £500.00p.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
